context: process-led · combustion & boiler islands · emissions commissioning

brief.intro: A waste-to-energy (WtE) plant burns municipal or industrial waste to raise steam and generate electricity. New to this type? Think of it as a small power station wrapped around a furnace: a combustion / boiler island (moving grate, furnace and boiler), a turbine-generator island, and a flue-gas treatment train that keeps emissions within permit. A waste bunker and heavy foundations are the big civil interfaces. The programme is procurement-led (long-lead boiler, turbine and grate) and its finish is gated by emissions commissioning — the plant cannot hand over until the stack meets its permit.

scope.name: Enabling & heavy civil
scope.desc: Earthworks, piling and heavy foundations for the boiler house, turbine and stack.

scope.name: Waste bunker & tipping hall
scope.desc: Deep waste-storage bunker, tipping hall and crane rails.

scope.name: Boiler house structure
scope.desc: Tall steel/concrete structure enclosing the combustion and boiler island.

scope.name: Combustion grate & furnace
scope.desc: Moving grate, furnace and refractory that burn the waste.

scope.name: Boiler & steam system
scope.desc: Boiler / heat-recovery, steam drum, feedwater and steam pipework.

scope.name: Turbine-generator island
scope.desc: Steam turbine, generator, condenser and cooling.

scope.name: Flue-gas treatment
scope.desc: Scrubbers, bag filters and NOx reduction (SCR/SNCR) to meet emission limits.

scope.name: Ash & residue handling
scope.desc: Bottom-ash and fly-ash extraction, treatment and storage.

scope.name: Electrical & balance of plant
scope.desc: Generator connection, HV/MV distribution, transformers and BOP power.

scope.name: Controls (DCS) & CEMS
scope.desc: Distributed control system and continuous emissions monitoring.

scope.name: Testing & commissioning
scope.desc: Hydrotest, first fire, steam blows, trial burn and emissions / performance test.

must_get_right: Boiler, turbine and grate are the long-lead drivers — order them before civil design is complete.
Heavy civil and the waste bunker are critical early works; the boiler house structure gates equipment erection.
Flue-gas treatment and CEMS must be proven before the trial burn — emissions commissioning is permit-gated.
Sequence hydrotest → first fire → steam blows → trial burn with real contingency; hot commissioning re-tests are common.

basis_of_planning.standard: AACE Recommended Practice 38R-06 — Documenting the Schedule Basis

sections.heading: Scheduling method & tools
sections.body: A Critical Path Method (CPM) network in Primavera P6, developed to a Level 3 control schedule with retained-logic progress and calculated by F9; total float kept ≥ 0 in the baseline. Discipline sub-networks (civil, mechanical, electrical, C&I) integrate at the equipment-erection and commissioning interfaces.

sections.heading: Calendars & working time
sections.body: Construction on a 6-day week; heavy-lift and outage windows planned discretely; commissioning on a 7-day calendar. Weather allowance in the piling / foundation phase.

sections.heading: Sequencing logic & critical path
sections.body: The driving path runs long-lead procurement → heavy civil & boiler house → boiler / turbine erection → hydrotest → electrical energisation → first fire → trial burn → handover. Procurement and hot commissioning, not the building, own the critical path.

sections.heading: Key assumptions
sections.body: Environmental permit and a secured waste-supply contract are in place; a single mobilisation; free-issue of no major equipment; and refractory dry-out and steam-blow windows are available when required.

sections.heading: Access, resource & site constraints
sections.body: Very heavy lifts (boiler modules, turbine, transformers) need crane windows and clear laydown; tall-structure and confined boiler working; specialist hot-commissioning resources shared across systems late in the programme.

sections.heading: Risks, float & contingency
sections.body: Principal risks: long-lead equipment slippage, emissions non-compliance at trial burn, and hot-commissioning re-test loops. Contingency is held before first fire and before the emissions / performance test.

sections.heading: Schedule levels of detail
sections.body: Reported at Level 1–2 to the client, controlled at Level 3, expanded to a Level 4–5 field lookahead — consistent with AACE 37R-06.
